g.text: A useful self-learning loop requires executable targets, adequate public information, and examples from the learner's own state distribution.

g.text: Reported goal-hold pilot: distance ≤ 0.25 m, speed ≤ 0.10 m/s, 50 consecutive control ticks; retain contact, fall and deadline failures.
